Some dishes you cook. Some dishes you carry.
Bhoger Khichuri is Bengal's most beloved festive recipe - a sacred, no-onion-no-garlic khichuri made with aromatic Gobindobhog rice and dry-roasted moong dal, cooked slow with mustard oil, whole spices, and a lot of memory. Paired with its quiet, crispy companion: Begun Bhaja.
This is the kind of dish that waits for you every year at Durga Puja. Served on sal leaf plates, from big steel barrels, in long courtyard queues. The kind that tastes like the best thing in the world, every single time.
